rv.q: A coat and hat alone on stage. Don Lockwood (Louis Gaunt) steps in, taps out a few quick steps, then slips into his film star persona. We are transported to 1920s Hollywood – a place where image matters more than truth.

Louis Gaunt as Don Lockwood and Carly Mercedes Dyer as Kathy Selden were a great pairing. Gaunt had the easy charm of a Hollywood leading man whilst bringing a real sweetness and sensitivity that really sold the relationship between Don and Kathy. His dancing skills were also phenomenal.
